statement: As an entrant, I want to search for campsites.
acceptance: Typing a name or place shows matching campsites.

statement: As an entrant, I want to filter campsites by location, date, and number of guests.
acceptance: Location, dates, and guest count filters can be used together.

statement: As an entrant, I want to see a list of campsites based on my filters.
acceptance: The list updates when filters are applied or cleared.

statement: As an entrant, I want to see campsite summary information including name, location, maximum occupancy, and rating.
acceptance: Every campsite card shows name, place, max guests, and rating (or Not rated).

statement: As an entrant, I want to see details of a campsite.
acceptance: Details show price, rules, stay dates, image if present, and a View on map button.

statement: As an entrant, I want to join an active lottery from the campsite details screen.
acceptance: Join Lottery is shown on details only while registration is open.

statement: As an entrant, I want to join the waiting list for a campsite lottery.
acceptance: One entrant can join a lottery once; joining saves a waitlist record.

statement: As an entrant, I want to leave the waiting list for a campsite lottery.
acceptance: An entrant can leave before registration closes; the entry is removed or marked left.

statement: As an entrant, I want to receive a notification when I win the campsite lottery.
acceptance: Selected entrants have a saved win notice and receive FCM push when enabled.

statement: As an entrant, I want to receive a notification when I lose the campsite lottery.
acceptance: Not selected entrants have a saved loss notice and receive FCM push when enabled.

statement: As an entrant, if I win the lottery, I want to see available dates that I can reserve the campsite for.
acceptance: A winner sees only stay dates that are still open to book.

statement: As an entrant, if I win a multiple campsite lottery, I want to choose which campsite to reserve and which dates I want.
acceptance: For a multi-site lottery, the winner picks one offered campsite and open dates.

statement: As an entrant, if I win the lottery, I want to decline a reservation if I changed my mind or if none of the remaining dates work for me.
acceptance: Declining closes the offer so it cannot be booked later.

statement: As an entrant, I want to receive confirmation of my campsite reservation.
acceptance: A finished booking shows a confirmation screen and reservation number.

statement: As an entrant, I want to receive reservation by notification or downloadable CSV.
acceptance: The user can save a simple CSV receipt on their phone.

statement: As an entrant, I want to view a list of my active reservations.
acceptance: Upcoming confirmed reservations show in the Active tab.

statement: As an entrant, I want to view a list of my past reservations.
acceptance: Finished stays show in the Past tab.

statement: As an entrant, I want to cancel my campsite reservation.
acceptance: Cancel asks for confirmation and frees the saved dates.

statement: As an entrant, I want to receive confirmation of my campsite cancellation by notification or downloadable CSV.
acceptance: A cancellation notice is saved; the user can also save a CSV receipt.

statement: As an entrant, I want to update my personal information, such as name, email, and phone number, on my profile.
acceptance: The entrant can edit name, email, phone, and a small profile photo.

statement: As an entrant, I want to delete my profile.
acceptance: Delete profile asks to confirm, handles active bookings, and removes user data.

statement: As an entrant, I want to be identified by my device, so that I do not have to use a username and password.
acceptance: The app signs in anonymously and keeps the same user while app data is kept.

statement: As an entrant, I want to opt out of receiving notifications.
acceptance: Turning off alerts prevents push messages; the app still shows important status.

statement: As an entrant, I want to see the app policy and guidelines.
acceptance: The app has a read-only Policy and Guidelines page.

statement: As an entrant, I want to view campsite details by scanning the promotional QR code.
acceptance: Scanning a valid campsite QR opens that campsite; invalid codes show an error.

statement: As an entrant, I want to give a rating for a campsite.
acceptance: A signed-in entrant can save or update one 1-to-5 rating per campsite.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want to register my campsite with the app.
acceptance: An owner can create and save a campsite listing.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want to provide campsite details including name, location, description (amenities), maximum occupancy, map location, optional image, and tags.
acceptance: The form saves required details, geo coordinates, stay dates, price, rules, and an optional compressed image.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want to update details about my campsite.
acceptance: The owner can change the campsite details they own.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want to view details of my campsite.
acceptance: The owner can open a details page for their campsite.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want the system to generate a unique QR code that links to the campsite details.
acceptance: The owner can view and save a QR code holding the campsite ID.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want to view a list of my campsites.
acceptance: The owner sees only campsites they own.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want to list my campsite in a lottery for a certain period.
acceptance: The owner can publish one campsite in a lottery.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want be able to list multiple campsites in a lottery for a certain period.
acceptance: The owner can choose two or more of their campsites for one lottery.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want to set a registration period.
acceptance: A lottery saves open and close times for registration.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want to set a booking period.
acceptance: The owner can set the time window when winners may book.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want to set the number of lottery winners.
acceptance: The owner can enter how many winners will be drawn.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want to update my campsite lottery listing.
acceptance: The owner can update a lottery before it closes, with safe edit rules.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want to optionally set a capacity for my lottery waitlist.
acceptance: The owner can leave waitlist uncapped or enter a maximum number.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want the system to automatically draw winners after the registration period ends.
acceptance: A scheduled job draws distinct winners after closing, once per lottery.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want to view the currently booked dates for my campsite.
acceptance: A calendar marks nights already reserved for each campsite.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want to view a list of active reservations.
acceptance: The owner sees active reservations for their own campsites.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want to view a list of past reservations.
acceptance: The owner sees past reservations for their own campsites.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want to view a list of cancelled reservations.
acceptance: The owner sees cancelled and rejected reservations.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want to reject a reservation.
acceptance: The owner can reject a reservation for their campsite and free the nights.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want to view a list of entrants who have joined the waitlist for my campsite lottery.
acceptance: The owner can see entrants who joined the selected lottery.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want to send notifications to entrants who have joined the waitlist for my campsite lottery.
acceptance: The owner can send a one-way notice to the lottery waitlist.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want to view a list of all notifications I have sent.
acceptance: The owner can see a record of the notices they sent.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want entrants to confirm that they have read the campsite rules and policies before confirming their reservation.
acceptance: The entrant must tick I read the rules before booking is allowed.

statement: As a campsite owner, I want to message a user who is reserving my campsite.
acceptance: The owner can send a private one-way message to a booked entrant.

statement: As an admin, I want to remove registered campsites.
acceptance: The admin can remove a campsite, after a confirm dialog.

statement: As an admin, I want to remove profiles.
acceptance: The admin can disable or remove an entrant profile.

statement: As an admin, I want to remove images.
acceptance: The admin can remove a profile or promo image.

statement: As an admin, I want to browse campsites.
acceptance: The admin can browse all campsite listings.

statement: As an admin, I want to browse profiles.
acceptance: The admin can browse user profiles.

statement: As an admin, I want to browse uploaded images so I can remove them if necessary.
acceptance: The admin can browse saved profile and campsite images.

statement: As an admin, I want to remove campsite owners that violate app policy.
acceptance: The admin can disable an owner and hide the owner’s campsites.

statement: As an admin, I want to review logs of all notifications.
acceptance: The admin can view saved notification records.

statement: As an admin, I should be able to be a campsite owner and/or entrant with my admin profile.
acceptance: The admin can also use normal Entrant and Owner tabs on the same account.

statement: As an admin, I want to review logs of all messages from campsite owners to entrants who reserved their campsite.
acceptance: The admin can read one-way owner-to-entrant message records.

statement: As an entrant, I want the campsite list sorted by how well it matches my search filters.
acceptance: The list can sort by a simple 0–100 match score using location, dates, and guest count.
